units.chi2: PDielec Angstrom-based chi^(2) convention, compatible with R_epsilon; null if unavailable
units.mass_weighted_eigenvector: dimensionless, normalized eigenvector in mass-weighted coordinates

chi2_convention: chi2[i,j,k] = d epsilon_inf[i,j] / d E_k / (8*pi), E in V/Angstrom; experimental finite-field estimate for PDielec EO workflow
deps_dr_convention: deps_dr[a,k,i,j] = partial epsilon[i,j] / partial r[a,k], r in Angstrom

elastic_summary.lo_frequency_note: TO frequencies are parsed from VASP. LO frequencies require a non-analytic correction calculation; this script records the Born charges and epsilon_inf needed for that next step.
